ANC4 Coverage for Gaya and Nalanda (2021‑2023)

ANC4 coverage is the percentage of registered pregnancies that completed at least four antenatal check‑ups. It is calculated as (anc4_completed / pregnancies_registered) × 100. The data are synthetic and may not reflect real‑world values.
